bullets.text: At Thiruvallur, North Chennai Thermal Power Station reported a 600 MW power generation drop due to a boiler tube leak, requiring immediate technical review.
In Chennai, a 10-foot giant sinkhole opened up on the OMR in Perungudi due to a drainage leak, and the office should monitor traffic and repair works.
In Chennai, a 20-year-old named Manoj was injured after chasing cattle thieves and crashing his bike, and the office should track police action.
A netizen urged the minister to apply the same road-widening speed to the Velachery-Tambaram road as seen in Sankarankovil, and the office should note the feedback.
In Chennai, the Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal widening in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones for monsoon flood readiness, and the office should track progress.
In Kanagam, Tamil Nadu Housing Board residents protested against officials pressuring them to vacate homes they purchased, and the office should investigate the matter.
In Karambakkam, residents questioned the GCC and revenue department over constructing a PDS shop on a pond, and the office should watch for official clarifications.
Near Gummidipoondi, out-of-state Omni buses blocked an interstate border checkpost route in protest, causing traffic disruption that the district team must monitor.
In Thiruvallur, Collector Kavitha announced that 134 government buses are operating under the Chief Minister's victory journey scheme, which the district team should track.
In Avadi, Collector Kavitha and officials inspected dengue prevention measures, and the district team should watch public health compliance closely.
The government is introducing a face-scanning system in ration shops to replace fingerprints, and the portfolio team should monitor rollout efficiency.
In Coimbatore, Global Capability Centres are projected to grow significantly by 2032, and the portfolio team should support this technological expansion.
Apple removed the offline messaging app Bitchat from the India App Store following a MeitY takedown demand, and the portfolio team should note the compliance action.
Soumya Anbumani stated her party will pressure the government to gradually reduce liquor shops, and the office should watch political developments.
GK Vasan expressed that TVK has high winning prospects in upcoming bye-elections, and the office should note these political trends.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service, and the office should prepare.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the IITM-Maestro music centre at IIT Madras on October 11, merging culture and technology.
